name: 11 - Jev Ensemble v2 Multi-Symbol Market Direction

parameters.content:
## Jev Ensemble v2 (upgrade of "Jev 1.13 Market Direction Signal")

Runs hourly over a **watchlist of USDT perpetuals** instead of BTCUSDT only.
1. Load config + embedded watchlist (or top-N by volume); pull CoinDesk RSS headlines
2. Rank Binance USDT perps by 24h quote volume, keep top MAX_SYMBOLS_PER_RUN
3. For each symbol (in batches): fetch 1h+4h klines, premiumIndex (funding), OI history
4. Code: compute RSI/EMA/MACD/ATR/Bollinger/volume/taker-approx on both timeframes; regime + confluence; **crowding gate** (funding x OI blocks the crowded side)
5. IF not crowd-blocked: one TypeSafe call (direction Choice + strength Score + 4 Noul checks, parallel) -> combine with weights mirroring jev_market_direction.py
6. IF tradable (LONG/SHORT) AND cooldown clear -> Telegram alert. This file does not place orders.
7. EVERY scan (incl. skips) logged to Supabase; end-of-run digest optional

Paper trade first. All gates/thresholds/weights live in **Code: Config**.

## Setup

Env vars (docker-compose/.env, restart n8n):
TYPESAFE_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID,
SUPABASE_URL (https://xxx.supabase.co), SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

1. Create/extend the jev_signals table (see Schema note)
2. Click Execute Workflow once manually; inspect HTTP: TypeSafe Jev output.
   Answers arrive under .answers (direction.choice/probabilities/confidence, trend_strength.score, *.noul).
   If the key differs, fix the first line of Code: Combine to Signal.
3. Swap RSS: Crypto News for CryptoPanic if you want filtered market-moving headlines.
4. Pin MODEL in Config ("typesafe/jev-1.13"). Do not ship jev-latest.
5. OpenRouter alternative: use the OpenRouter Decisions endpoint with model
   "typesafe/jev-1.13" (https://openrouter.ai/typesafe/jev-1.13) instead of api.typesafe.ai;
   envelope stays {state, questions, model}.
6. This workflow does not place orders. LONG/SHORT is a proposal logged to jev_signals
   and optionally sent to Telegram. Execution stays in QuantumTrade Pro, behind the
   risk guard and the live four-number check. Do not add an order node here.

## Schema (run once in Supabase SQL editor)

-- original table kept compatible; add columns:
alter table jev_signals
  add column if not exists timeframe_scanned text,
  add column if not exists allowed_side text,
  add column if not exists blocked_reason text,
  add column if not exists regime_1h text,
  add column if not exists regime_4h text,
  add column if not exists confluence text,
  add column if not exists squeeze boolean,
  add column if not exists funding_annualized double precision,
  add column if not exists oi_change_pct_1h double precision,
  add column if not exists taker_buy_approx double precision,
  add column if not exists cooldown_skipped boolean,
  add column if not exists alert_sent boolean,
  add column if not exists next_candle_return double precision,
  add column if not exists outcome text,
  add column if not exists calibrated_at timestamptz;

-- daily backfill: match each logged row to the next realised candles and record
-- direction accuracy & average next-candle return. Tune N and window as needed.
create or replace function fill_outcomes_jev_signals() returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  -- placeholder: implement against your candle store (e.g. a candles table).
  -- update jev_signals set next_candle_return=..., outcome=..., calibrated_at=now()
  -- where outcome is null and created_at < now() - interval '1 day';
end;
$$;

## What changed vs v1 (jev_n8n_workflow.json)

| Area | v1 | v2 (this file) |
|---|---|---|
| Universe | BTCUSDT only | Watchlist/top-N USDT perps, looped in batches |
| Timeframes | 1h only | 1h signal + 4h confluence in state |
| State | TA only | TA + funding + OI change + approx taker ratio + news |
| Gating | Confidence/trend only | Plus crowding filter (fade the crowded side) |
| Alerts | Every hourly signal | Per-symbol cooldown dedup + optional digest |
| Logging | Supabase, single row | Batch upsert of every scan, incl. skips |
| Scoring | Hardcoded in Combine | Same rubric, weights pulled from Config |
| Execution | Disabled localhost stub | Removed. Telegram + Supabase log only |

Design rationale: fuse the seven monitoring workflows (funding/OI/TA/news/volume)
into one canonical per-symbol state, keep LLM outputs as ONE feature among many,
and log everything so gates can be tuned against realised outcomes.

parameters.jsCode:
// ---------------- Code: Config ----------------
const cfg = {
  WATCHLIST: [
    {"symbol":"BTCUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"King"},
    {"symbol":"ETHUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Large cap"},
    {"symbol":"SOLUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Large cap"},
    {"symbol":"BNBUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Exchange token"},
    {"symbol":"XRPUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Large cap"},
    {"symbol":"DOGEUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Meme/large cap"},
    {"symbol":"ADAUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Large cap"},
    {"symbol":"AVAXUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"L1"},
    {"symbol":"DOTUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"L1"},
    {"symbol":"LINKUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"Oracle"},
    {"symbol":"UNIUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"DeFi"},
    {"symbol":"NEARUSDT","enabled":true,"note":"L1"}
  ],
  MODE: "embedded",                       // "embedded" | "top_by_volume"
  MAX_SYMBOLS_PER_RUN: 12,                // cap symbols scanned per hourly run
  BATCH_SIZE: 1,                          // serial: bundle nodes use .first()
  CONFIDENCE_GATE: 0.60,                  // below -> NO_TRADE_LOW_CONFIDENCE
  STRENGTH_FLOOR: 1.5,                    // below -> NO_TRADE_WEAK_TREND (0..3 scale)
  SIGNAL_LONG: 0.25,                      // LONG  if signal_strength >  this
  SIGNAL_SHORT: -0.25,                    // SHORT if signal_strength <  this
  WEIGHT_NET: 0.40,
  WEIGHT_TREND: 0.15,
  WEIGHT_BREAKOUT: 0.15,
  WEIGHT_NEWS: 0.15,
  WEIGHT_RISKOFF: -0.10,
  WEIGHT_VOL: -0.10,
  FUNDING_BLOCK_LONG_ANNUAL: 0.30,        // annualized funding above this + OI spike -> block LONGs
  FUNDING_BLOCK_SHORT_ANNUAL: -0.10,      // annualized funding below this + OI drop -> block SHORTs
  OI_BLOCK_PCT: 3.0,                      // 1h OI move threshold for crowding block
  BB_SQUEEZE_WIDTH: 0.03,                 // Bollinger width < this -> squeeze regime
  COOLDOWN_HOURS: 4,                      // one Telegram alert per symbol per N hours
  SEND_DIGEST: false,                     // send end-of-run summary to TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
  MODEL: "typesafe/jev-1.13",             // pin the model; do NOT leave jev-latest in prod
  SUPABASE_TABLE: "jev_signals"
};
const ws = $getWorkflowStaticData("global");
ws.config = cfg;
ws.runId = Date.now();
ws.results = []; // reset per run: Flush + Digest read only this run's scans
if (!ws.symbolAlert) ws.symbolAlert = {};
return [{json:{config:cfg}}];
